Evidence & scope

Substantive bounded primary methods/results/limitations source review is documented at 2604.06802v3. Expert double-blind from-scratch verification and known-solution/private-problem limitations establish evaluation construction. No hidden problem corpus, independent verifier audit or general-intelligence conclusion. Original author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts bind every exact approved fact; unread pages, unreplicated experiments and source conflicts remain recorded in the pinned dossier. This admission is for one logical paper work only.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The problems have known solutions and the benchmark is private. The paper distinguishes this from genuinely open-ended mathematical research, where an answer’s existence can be unknown; benchmark privacy is an anticontamination design choice, not an independent demonstration that leakage or benchmark-selection bias is absent.

Permanent record ID: repair.qualbinding.20261111.v1.mandatory3.claim.arxiv.2604.06802.limitation

  • This is a source-specific, first-party description; this repair does not independently reproduce experiments or audit operational execution and customer outcomes.
  • Twenty-five selected research-level problems have known closed-form answers; active advanced-mathematics researchers author them, and two independent domain experts solve each from scratch blind to the author solution.
  • The benchmark is private and uses programmatic answer checks. Models have coding/search access and 100 independent runs per problem; Table 1 reports pass@1 for seven listed models.
  • The paper distinguishes these known-answer tasks from open-ended mathematical research where an answer may not be known to exist.
  • This author did not inspect private problems, credentials, trajectories, verification code or model runs; privacy alone is not an independent leakage or supplier-quality audit.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Riemann-Bench describes 25 expert-authored research-level problems with unique closed-form answers, programmatic answer checking and two independent domain experts solving each from scratch before acceptance. It evaluates agents with code/search over 100 independent runs per problem and reports pass@k estimators.
